title: What changed after the policy?
hook: Both groups changed. Which part of the change is the policy contrast?

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: two trend lines run in parallel; at the policy date one jumps, and the gap between the gaps is the effect.

misconception: Treating diff-in-diff, animated as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: two trend lines run in parallel; at the policy date one jumps, and the gap between the gaps is the effect.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: A control group goes 10→14 and treated group 12→21. Under a parallel-trends assumption, what is the difference-in-differences estimate?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-diff-in-diff-animated/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Control before/after 10→14, treated 12→21. Raw treated change9; control change4; difference-in-differences5. Add common shock+3 to both post outcomes; DiD remains5.

src/demos/probability/p100-diff-in-diff-animated/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Control before/after 10→14, treated 12→21. Raw treated change9; control change4; difference-in-differences5. Add common shock+3 to both post outcomes; DiD remains5.

claims.text: Both retained cases give DiD 5. Adding the same post-period shock changes both group trends by the same amount, so it cancels in the difference of changes.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-diff-in-diff-animated/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Control before/after 10→14, treated 12→21. Raw treated change9; control change4; difference-in-differences5. Add common shock+3 to both post outcomes; DiD remains5.

claims.text: The arithmetic alone does not establish causation. Interpreting 5 as a policy effect requires the treated group’s untreated trend to match the control trend, without a competing treated-only shock.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-diff-in-diff-animated/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Control before/after 10→14, treated 12→21. Raw treated change9; control change4; difference-in-differences5. Add common shock+3 to both post outcomes; DiD remains5.

claims.text: Control changes by 3 and treatment by 8. What is DiD? Subtract the control change from the treated change: 8−3=5.
